_comment: Deferred C# build warnings, keyed on (code, package-relative file).
An entry is a deferral with a written reason, not an exemption: the gate
fails on any warning that is not listed AND on any listed warning that no
longer fires, so this file cannot silently rot.
Compiler diagnostics (CS*, CA*) are at zero and must stay there. Fix the
warning; add an entry only when the fix genuinely belongs to someone else
(an SDK/analyzer regression, or a dependency's generated source).
xUnit warnings are real and should stay forbidden. The prior
C# warning-baseline included xUnit1031 entries for 28 call sites, and a
recent cleanup removed the synchronous-blocking call sites tracked as
Because the key is (code, file), a NEW file acquiring xUnit1031 still fails
the gate. The backlog cannot grow quietly, only shrink.
Enforced by ci/warning_gate.py, run from the `build` Makefile target.
